portal_hypertension.title: Incidental splenic artery aneurysms: systematic literature review and single-centre study.
portal_hypertension.authors: Lee RJ, Tong E, Alderson J
portal_hypertension.zhSummary: 该文聚焦门静脉高压症，属于综述研究。核心观点：我们将系统文献综述（2000-2025）与当地单中心回顾性队列相结合，评估偶发性脾动脉瘤的自然史、生长预测因素和破裂风险。 临床提示：脾动脉瘤（SAA）的自然病程和最佳治疗仍不确定。
portal_hypertension.abstract: The natural history and optimal management of splenic artery aneurysms (SAAs) remain uncertain. We combined a systematic literature review (2000-2025) with a local single-centre retrospective cohort to evaluate the natural history, predictors of growth, and rupture risk of incidental splenic artery aneurysms. A systematic review of 5 databases (2000-2025) identified longitudinal studies of true SAAs and were quality assessed. A parallel local retrospective cohort of untreated SAA diagnosed on computed tomography (CT) (2008-2023) was analysed. Demographic, imaging, and clinical factors were examined for associations with growth and rupture. Eight studies plus our local cohort yielded 1774 SAA...

portal_hypertension.title: Clinical and hemodynamic evaluation of schistosomiasis-associated pulmonary arterial hypertension from Egyptian pulmonary hypertension centers: epidemiology, risk factors, and survival determinants.
portal_hypertension.authors: Soliman YMA, El-Kassas M, ElAziz AA
portal_hypertension.zhSummary: 该文聚焦门静脉高压症，属于临床研究（样本量约为 83）。核心观点：血吸虫病相关的 PAH (Sch-PAH) 属于 I 类肺动脉高压，影响着 2.3 亿人，主要分布在撒哈拉以南非洲地区。 临床提示：这一重大负担促使人们对 Sch-PAH 的临床特征和结果进行研究，以提高认识和管理，特别是在发展中地区。
portal_hypertension.abstract: Schistosomiasis-associated PAH (Sch-PAH) falls under group I pulmonary hypertension and it affects 230 million people, mainly in sub-Saharan Africa. This significant burden has prompted studies on the clinical characteristics and outcomes of Sch-PAH to improve awareness and management, particularly in developing regions. This study investigates the characteristics of Sch-PAH, including demographics, clinical and hemodynamic features, and survival outcomes compared to idiopathic Pulmonary arterial hypertension (IPAH), while evaluating the prognosis and current clinical practices. A cohort of 83 patients, including 41 with Sch-PAH and 42 with IPAH, were studied retrospectively over five years ...

portal_hypertension.title: Rheumatic Heart Disease Is Not Over: Cardiac Cirrhosis and Multivalvular Sequelae in an Endemic Setting - A Case Series and Review.
portal_hypertension.authors: Sethi Y, Yadav ND, Singhal S
portal_hypertension.zhSummary: 该文聚焦门静脉高压症，属于综述研究。核心观点：尽管高收入国家的发病率有所下降，但风湿性心脏病（RHD）仍然是流行地区瓣膜病发病的主要原因。 临床提示：虽然早期疾病表现为急性风湿热，但当代的表现越来越多地反映出晚期结构性后遗症。
portal_hypertension.abstract: Rheumatic Heart Disease (RHD) remains a major cause of valvular morbidity in endemic regions despite declining incidence in high-income countries. While early disease manifests as acute rheumatic fever, contemporary presentations increasingly reflect advanced structural sequelae. Congestive hepatopathy and cardiac cirrhosis secondary to chronic right-sided failure remain under-recognized manifestations of advanced rheumatic valvular disease.
